calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS rank,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN frl.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN frl.refund_net ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON fsl.store_key = s.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web shop and training store
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'  -- Exclude test articles
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
WITH product_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN frl.return_line_id IS NOT NULL THEN frl.refund_net ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON fsl.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  INNER JOIN dim_product p ON fsl.product_key = p.product_key
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON fsl.store_key = s.store_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- Exclude web shop and training store
    AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'  -- Exclude test articles
  GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
)
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_sales DESC) AS rank,
  sku,
  product_name,
  net_sales
FROM product_sales
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
LIMIT 10
